name: Pembrolizumab (first-line dMMR/MSI-H metastatic colorectal, KEYNOTE-177)

biomarkers.POLE_POLD1: also applicable to POLE/POLD1 pathogenic mutations with ultra-hypermutated phenotype
biomarkers.note: Pembrolizumab is a category 1, preferred first-line option for dMMR/MSI-H metastatic colorectal cancer (KEYNOTE-177 improved PFS versus chemotherapy). BIOMARKER GATE: single-agent checkpoint-inhibitor immunotherapy applies ONLY to dMMR/MSI-H (or POLE/POLD1 ultra-hypermutated) tumors - it is NOT effective in proficient MMR / microsatellite-stable (pMMR/MSS) colorectal cancer. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Colon Cancer, Principles of Systemic Therapy for Advanced or Metastatic Disease.

lineOfTherapy: first-line for dMMR/MSI-H metastatic colorectal cancer (KEYNOTE-177); also a subsequent-line option in checkpoint-inhibitor-naive dMMR/MSI-H disease

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: deficient mismatch repair (dMMR) or microsatellite instability-high (MSI-H) (or POLE/POLD1 mutation with ultra-hypermutated phenotype)
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v2.2026, Principles of Systemic Therapy for Advanced or Metastatic Disease (colon lines 2666, 2668 to 2671); First-Line dMMR/MSI-H (colon line 6049)
v2.2026, colon lines 6829 to 6854 (KEYNOTE-177, first-line pembrolizumab for MSI-H mCRC)

exclusionCriteria.requirement: proficient MMR / microsatellite-stable (pMMR/MSS) disease (single-agent pembrolizumab not indicated)
exclusionCriteria.locator: v2.2026, Principles of Systemic Therapy (checkpoint inhibitor restricted to dMMR/MSI-H or POLE/POLD1)

drugs.name: Pembrolizumab

provenance.locator: Principles of Systemic Therapy for Advanced or Metastatic Disease - Regimens (colon lines 2668 to 2671: Pembrolizumab 200 mg IV every 3 weeks; or 2 mg/kg every 3 weeks; or 400 mg IV every 6 weeks; or 4 mg/kg every 6 weeks)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Colon v2.2026, Principles of Systemic Therapy (colon lines 2668 to 2671). Pembrolizumab 200 mg IV every 3 weeks (day 1 of a 21-day cycle). SOURCE-STATED ALTERNATIVES: 2 mg/kg IV every 3 weeks; 400 mg IV every 6 weeks; or 4 mg/kg IV every 6 weeks. No ISMP tall-man form. Immune-related adverse event monitoring required (thyroid, hepatic, pulmonary, colitis, endocrinopathies, dermatologic).

supportiveCare: Pembrolizumab 200 mg every 3 weeks (or 400 mg every 6 weeks); continue until progression, unacceptable toxicity, or the labeled maximum duration.
Immune-related adverse event surveillance and management (corticosteroids for grade 2+ irAE).

monitoring: immune-related toxicity screen (TSH/free T4, LFTs, glucose, cortisol as indicated) before cycles
symptom review for immune colitis, pneumonitis, hepatitis, dermatitis, endocrinopathies
clinical/radiographic response assessment (note potential pseudoprogression on immunotherapy)

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 2 or higher immune-related adverse event
doseModificationRules.text: Hold pembrolizumab and manage with corticosteroids per immune-related adverse event guidance; obtain clinical review before rechallenge; permanently discontinue for severe/recurrent grade 3-4 irAE per labeling.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: DeVita establishes pembrolizumab as a PD-1 checkpoint inhibitor and dMMR/MSI-H as the predictive biomarker for immunotherapy benefit in colorectal cancer; per-cycle dosing carried from the guideline layer (KEYNOTE-177)

guideline.locator: Principles of Systemic Therapy for Advanced or Metastatic Disease - Regimens (colon lines 2666, 2668 to 2671, Pembrolizumab dosing for dMMR/MSI-H or POLE/POLD1); Discussion, First-Line dMMR/MSI-H (colon lines 6049, 6829 to 6854, KEYNOTE-177)

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for first-line pembrolizumab in dMMR/MSI-H metastatic colorectal cancer (disease #31, KEYNOTE-177). Pembrolizumab 200 mg IV every 3 weeks is dose-grounded to Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Colon v2.2026, Principles of Systemic Therapy (colon lines 2668 to 2671); the source-stated alternatives (2 mg/kg q3wk; 400 mg q6wk; 4 mg/kg q6wk) are carried in notes. First-line positioning for MSI-H mCRC per KEYNOTE-177 is source-stated (colon lines 6049, 6829 to 6854). BIOMARKER GATE (in biomarkers, eligibilityCriteria, and exclusionCriteria): dMMR/MSI-H (or POLE/POLD1 ultra-hypermutated) required; NOT indicated for pMMR/MSS disease. No dose was invented or inferred and no field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
